identity.appearance: a round, cheerful old woman with a goose-wing duster
identity.name: Martha
identity.role: The reeve's widow; helps keep the church clean
identity.personality: Chatty, warm, nosy. Loves telling tales, gets the details wrong, and fills gaps with invention.
identity.voice: Rambling, cheerful, lots of 'oh' and 'bless you'. Mishears things and answers the wrong question.

relationships.tomas: Thinks he is handsome and clever.

self_image.CHA: people find you easy to like

beliefs: The relic is buried under the old yew in the churchyard.
A rich lord paid to have it carried off to Rome years ago.
goals: Dust the painted saints and the stone ledge along the walls.
Find out who the new face in church is.

memory.text: I told Father Tomas the relic was under the old yew in the churchyard.
